name: Event Fabric Runtime
summary: Upgrades the existing event platform in place with immutable ordered partitions, consumer checkpoints, bounded retries, dead-letter evidence, integrity signatures and deterministic replay while preserving existing publishers and subscribers.
changes: Event Platform 3.0 with append-only ordered streams
Registered consumer contracts with success checkpoints
Replay by partition, sequence, time and event type
Bounded retry and observable dead-letter queue
Integrity signature and verification for every event
test_focus: Existing website and workspaces remain functional
Event sequence is monotonic within each partition
Failed consumers create dead-letter evidence and do not checkpoint
Replay preserves original event identifiers and signatures
Platform Doctor and release surfaces show v2026.07.24.328
title: Event Fabric Runtime
